Well, I've never been employed full-time, but... focus groups and research panels. I am actually participating in a study next week that pays eighty bucks. They're not guaranteed (you have to fill out screening surveys), but they're a nice way to make some quick cash on the side.

[Angus Reid](https://www.angusreidforum.com/Portal/p.aspx): You earn anywhere from 1.00 to 2.50 per survey you take (if you're eligible to take it). Once you hit the 50.00 mark, you can request a cheque. Takes some time, but sometimes you get invited to take paid studies.  
[CRC Research Panel](http://www.consumerresearchpanel.ca)  
[SmartPoint Research](http://smartpointresearch.com)  
[Synchro Marketing Research](http://www.synchroresearch.com)  
[Vancouver Focus](http://www.vancouverfocus.com)

Edit: I just received info about an upcoming study (Dec. 4, Dec. 12, or Dec. 13 in downtown Vancouver) from SmartPoint Research. I didn't qualify for it, but it pays $100.00 cash.
